name: Westerhill Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura public consultation site describes a 300MW data centre campus at Westerhill Regeneration Area in East Dunbartonshire. Scottish Government DPEA case for proposed data centre campus at land east of Crosshill Road, Westerhill, Glasgow, shows receipt 2025-09-25 and EIA Required decision issued 2025-11-07.

name: Cockenzie former coal store hyperscale data centre
developer: Sustainable Development Capital LLP / East Lothian Council
notes: East Lothian Council selected SDCL as preferred supplier for a potential hyperscale data centre at the former Cockenzie coal storage site. Source says legal agreements, consultation, and planning still required; no capacity disclosed.

name: Larbert Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura describes a proposed 300MW campus beside Glenbervie Business Park on Bellsdyke Road, Larbert. Scottish Construction Now reported on 2026-06-10 that plans were submitted to Falkirk Council and accepted; operations scheduled for 2028 if approved.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Cato hyperscale data centre near Auchtertool
notes: DCD reports ILI Group submitted an application to Fife Council for planning permission in principle for Cato, a proposed 600MW hyperscale data centre near Auchtertool in Fife. Development is described as 25 ha with up to seven buildings and an on-site substation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: DataVita DV2 Data Centre Glasgow
notes: DataVita lists DV2 as its newest Glasgow city-centre data centre at 177 Bothwell Street, with Tier III design, 130 racks, and 1MW power available. Invest Glasgow reported the project as a planned GBP 6m metro data centre expected operational in Q3 2022.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: MeyGen ocean-powered data centre scheme
notes: Invest Highland lists MeyGen as a data centre development scheme promoted by SIMEC Atlantis Energy and located on 20+ ha in Caithness, status greenfield and short-term. Earlier developer announcement described plans for an ocean-powered data centre tied to MeyGen tidal generation, but no recent planning/capacity evidence was found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Former IBM Site, Spango Valley, Greenock data centre and BESS
notes: Project consultation site states Slate Island Developments is proposing a data centre at the former IBM site, Spango Valley, Greenock, alongside a co-located BESS, with a PAN submitted to Inverclyde Council. DCD reported the BESS is 99MW and data centre plans show two large buildings, but data centre MW capacity has not been shared.
